sloka: द्विविदः शोणिताक्षं तु विददार नखैर्मुखे।निष्पिपेष च वगेन क्षितावाविध्य वीर्यवान् ।। ६.७६.३३ ।।
transliteration: dvividaḥ śoṇitākṣaṁ tu vidadāra nakhairmukhe।niṣpipeṣa ca vagena kṣitāvāvidhya vīryavān ।। 6.76.33 ।।

translations.english: Valiant Dwivida, for his part, tore Sonitaksha on his face with his nails, and quickening his pace threw him on the surface of the ground and bruised him.
translations.hindi: इसने सेकझे देवताओं और दानर्वो को पराजित कर गक्षसों को रक्षा की हे और यक्षो का संहार किआ है
